articles.headline: Now Ready! Masonry and Christianity! Rev. Theo. Doughty Miller's Great Sermon (advertisement)
articles.summary: NOW READY! Masonry and Christianity! Rev. Theo. Doughty Miller's Great Sermon, as delivered before the higher orders of [Masonry], at the Central Presbyterian church. Sold at 25 cents per copy, and may be had of the Committee or of the author, [No. illegible] Quince Street. Every Mason and every opposer of Masonry should have a copy. May 25-4 on ha.(?)
people: author of the sermon (Rev.); printed 'Rev. Theo. Doughty Miller's'; middle name partly broken in the type
